integrity: The infinite-parameter theorem is proved by strict convexity, full spectral decomposition, sharp Cauchy-Schwarz and a budget-comparison argument; programmatic checks are corroborating finite tests and do not constitute independent review.
scientific_limitations: Complete graphs K_n with n>=4, exactly one distinguished edge price, independently chosen nonnegative edge conductances, total pairwise effective resistance under a linear budget. Not asserted for several exceptional prices, fixed positive lower bounds, or other loss criteria. Priority remains subject to specialized unlocated literature.
title: The exceptional-edge price frontier for total resistance on complete graphs
